CaribouLite radio controller
Type help for commands; status refreshes the display.
q disconnects and unkeys any owned TX.

  LIVE | RF24 | RX
  ------------------------------------------------------------
  Receive
    Frequency        430.100812 MHz
    Mode             CW
    Sample rate      1 MS/s
    Noise squelch    Not Applicable
    Carrier squelch  Off

  Transmit
    Frequency        430.100000 MHz
    Power            -12 dBm
    Mode             CW
    Sample rate      1 MS/s
    Audio source     Microphone

H650e call button: observe only. Unplug or controller exit releases owned TX.
Headset call click (observe only; RF unchanged).
